summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts the bun binary, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js (falling back to a bun already on PATH if present). math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated Bun bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header, string-array shuffling, hex-named identifiers, large encoded constant table) that is not referenced by the package's main entry and is not built from any shipped source. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (execute an opaque payload under a freshly-downloaded language runtime rather than Node) evades Node-focused inspection. The declared purpose of the package is a small routing/re-export library, which does not require a second language runtime or a 700KB obfuscated bundle to function. The download-runtime-then-execute-obfuscated-blob chain fires unconditionally on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
